issue_context.title: networkd: optionally change static (and not just transient) hostname based on acquired DHCP lease data
issue_context.body:
The hostname via option12 should be able to be set static for the host. So that hostname and login screens /etc/hostname and /etc/hosts are adapted if the dhcp server send the hostname.

this was possible in the past with dhcpdclient and exit hooks.
comments:
Hmm, yeah, it might make sense to add an option to optionally make DHCP hostname info persistent, if possible, but it definitely shouldn't be the default.

/etc/hosts should never be updated though, it has nothing to do with DHCP.

and "login screens" (you mean gdm and the lot?) display the kernel hostname, so for them this should not be necessary

review_comments: `both`? I do not have any reason to set both transient and static hostname. Note that `SetStaticHostname` method updates /etc/hostname and sets kernel hostname. While `SetHostname` just set the kernel hostname. So, calling both method is meaningless.
The idea behind the both is clear logic what going to happen as you said above. If you think it's reductact we can drop this and update in man only.
Not a big matter, but the name `bool static_hostname` is redundant, `bool static` or `bool is_static` is enough.
It is not necessary to `strdup()` the method name.
